integrity: Proof is analytic; derivative and normalization identities also independently recomputed by embedded exact symbolic checker. Source-paper limit theorem is adopted, not reproved.
scientific_limitations: Fixed scaled strategy mutation mu=1, four-state cyclic phenotype space, positive discrimination, weak selection, large-population stationary-abundance criterion. No higher-cycle, finite-census or general mu claim.
title: A unique phenotype-mutation optimum on the four-state recognition cycle
